hypothesis: A reusable production small-dual plan can omit unreachable generic transform dependencies and retain only Algorithm 4/5 metadata, reducing plan setup without changing execution.

candidate.behavior: specialized-only transform metadata when direct_transform_fallback is true

control.behavior: generic plus specialized metadata for native-high AUTO plans

kill_criterion: Reject if setup does not improve credibly by at least 5 percent across the target region or any neighboring amortized cell regresses by more than 2 percent.
conclusion: The change was effectively inert for translated-low K5, produced only a marginal native-high setup reduction, and did not improve amortized decode. The important K16/R8/loss8/1023-byte point estimate moved backward. The code was removed rather than adding another production policy branch.
